The role involves monitoring system performance, troubleshooting technical issues, managing user access, implementing cybersecurity measures, and supporting technology upgrades. This position is integral to maintaining business continuity, enhancing operational efficiency, and providing a stable technology environment that supports Rushlee's workforce and ongoing business growth.   Benefits   Competitive remuneration   Full-time, stable employment with a growing, locally owned business  Supportive team environment with a focus on safety and professionalism    Task & responsibilities   Install, configure, administer, and maintain the organisation's servers, operating systems, business applications, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure to ensure reliable and secure operations.  Monitor the performance, availability, and security of IT systems and networks, proactively identifying and resolving issues to minimise downtime.  Manage user accounts, access permissions, email services, and authentication controls in accordance with organisational security policies.  Provide technical support to employees by diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and system-related issues in a timely manner.  Implement, maintain, and monitor cybersecurity measures, including firewalls, endpoint protection, system updates, backups, and disaster recovery processes to safeguard organisational data.  Perform routine system maintenance, software upgrades, security patching, and configuration management to optimise system performance and reliability.  Administer and maintain databases, data storage solutions, and backup systems to ensure data integrity, availability, and secure information management.  Develop and maintain IT documentation, system configurations, operational procedures, and asset registers to support effective system administration.  Liaise with external technology vendors and service providers to coordinate system maintenance, software licensing, technical support, and infrastructure upgrades.  Support and maintain business technology including workstations, mobile devices, telecommunications systems, printers, and remote access solutions.  Assist management in planning, implementing, and improving IT infrastructure and technology solutions that enhance operational efficiency and support business growth.  Ensure all IT systems and practices comply with organisational policies, privacy obligations, cybersecurity standards, and other applicable regulatory requirements.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Administration, Systems Administration, or a related field.  Minimum 1 year of full-time relevant work experience (or equivalent part-time/casual experience) in systems administration, IT support, or network administration.  Demonstrated experience administering Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, cloud platforms, and business IT systems.  Sound knowledge of networking technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routers, switches, and wireless networks.  Experience managing system security, backups, disaster recovery, and software updates.  Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network environments.  Excellent organisational, communication, and time management skills.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively while providing technical support to end users.  Knowledge of information security, data privacy, and compliance requirements, with healthcare or community services experience being advantageous.   About Company     Rushlee Pty Ltd is a Geelong-based information technology company specialising in network infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud networking, IT support, and system administration services. result.description:
REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS (RECRUITER) on behalf of OneCare Priority Services Pty Ltd T/A OneCare Priority Services

Employer: OneCare Priority Services Pty Ltd T/A One Care Priority Services
Location: Campbelltown, South Australia 5074
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: AUD $72,000 – $82,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Organization:

OneCare Priority Services is a registered NDIS service provider committed to delivering high-
quality, person-centred support to individuals with disabilities, injuries, and mental health conditions. The organisation is dedicated to promoting independence, inclusion, and dignity through tailored support services across Adelaide and surrounding regions.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Aged or Disabled Carer to provide direct care and support services in accordance with individual care plans and organisational policies. The role focuses on enhancing clients’ independence, community participation, and overall wellbeing.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

•	Provide personal care including assistance with daily living activities such as grooming, dressing, and mobility support
•	Support clients in accessing community activities, employment, and social engagement
•	Assist with implementation of individual support plans and behavioural programs
•	Monitor client wellbeing and report any concerns in accordance with organisational procedures
•	Maintain accurate documentation including client progress notes and reports
•	Support medication administration in line with company policies
•	Work collaboratively with families, carers, case managers, and allied health professionals
•	Ensure compliance with NDIS standards, workplace health and safety requirements, and internal policies

Skills and Experience:

•	AQF Certificate III in Individual support or higher relevant qualification is required.
•	A minimum of 12 months relevant experience in aged or disability care services is required, with a minimum of 20 hours per week. This experience may be gained through full-time, part-time, or casual employment.
•	Valid Australian driver license is must, along with comprehensive car insurance.
•	Applicants must be willing to accept shift allocations at client locations across metropolitan, regional, and outer regional South Australia, depending on operational requirements and client care needs. Flexibility to travel between client locations is an essential requirement of this position.
•	Strong interpersonal skills, a compassionate, patient approach.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of team.
•	A valid National Police Check, Working with Children Check and other NDIS entry level certificates are required.
•	First Aid, Manual Handling and CPR Certificate is required.
Additional Requirements:
•	Ability to perform physical tasks including manual handling and mobility support
•	Willingness to undertake ongoing training including WHS, infection control, and medication administration

BENEFITS

•	Work in a supportive and inclusive team environment.
•	Opportunities for career development and training.
•	Flexible working arrangements to suit your lifestyle.
•	Meaningful work where you make a real impact.
•	Opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of others


ABOUT US

One Care Priority Services is a South Australia-based disability support provider located at 567 Lower North East Road, Campbelltown SA 5074, committed to delivering high-quality, person-centred services to individuals living with disabilities, injuries, and mental health conditions. The organisation operates across Adelaide and surrounding regions, supporting participants under the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS).

The company is focused on enhancing the quality of life of its clients by providing tailored support services that promote independence, dignity, and active participation in the community. All services are delivered in accordance with NDIS Practice Standards, relevant legislation, and organisational policies.
